blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Industrial anomaly detection plays a pivotal role in precision manufacturing, where joint analysis of multimodal data emerges as a critical approach to enhance detection accuracy. Feature reconstruction, a dominant paradigm for such joint analysis, is primarily implemented through intra-modal and cross-modal methods, both of which are plagued by significant limitations. Intra-modal reconstruction neglects complementary cross-modal information, while its cross-modal counterpart is prone to projection errors and ambiguous one-to-many mappings (e.g., same textures mapping to multiple geometries), leading to detection failures. To address these limitations, we propose a novel feature reconstruction paradigm, Fuse Before Reconstruct (FBR), which first fuses multimodal features and then performs reconstruction for anomaly detection. Firstly, we propose a bidirectional cross-modal attention mechanism to achieve deep feature complementarity between image and point cloud features, mitigating projection bias through channel alignment and dynamic spatial prior integration. Besides, a learnable pixel-wise gated fusion strategy is adopted to preserve multi-modal structural consistency while optimizing local feature combination. Finally, dual-path collaborative reconstruction is implemented to recover original modal features from the fused representations, where cross-modal consistency constraints effectively eliminate mapping ambiguities. Extensive experiments show that FBR achieves 98.3% I-AUROC on MVTec 3D-AD and 92.6% I-AUROC on Eyecandies, surpassing previous state-of-the-art methods by +2.9% and +4.1%, respectively.
blocks.zh: 工业异常检测在精密制造中发挥着关键作用,在精密制造中,联合分析多式联运数据成为提高精密检测的关键方法。 特征重建是此类联合分析的主要范例,主要通过模式内和跨模式方法实施,这两种方法都受到重大限制的困扰。 模式内重建忽略了互补的跨模式信息,而其跨模式对应方则容易出现投影错误和模棱两可的一对多种绘图(如同一纹理映射到多个几何),导致检测失败. 为了克服这些局限性,我们提出了一个新的特征重建范式,即Fuse Before Reconstruct (FBR),它首先将多式联运特征引信化,然后进行异常探测的重建。 首先,我们建议建立一个双向跨模式关注机制,以实现图像和点云特征之间的深度互补,通过信道对齐和动态空间前集成来减少投影偏差。 此外,还采用了可学习的像素-视门式聚变战略,以保持多模式结构的一致性,同时优化本地特征组合。 最后,还开展了双向协作重建,以从组合的表述中恢复原始模式特征,因为交叉模式的一致性限制有效地消除了绘图的模糊性。 广泛的实验表明,FBR在MVTec 3D-AD上实现了98.3%的I-AUROC,在眼罩上实现了92.6%的I-AUROC,分别以+2.9%和+4.1%。

blocks.en: 1 INTRODUCTION
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Industrial Anomaly Detection has emerged as a pivotal technology in precision manufacturing [ 1 ] , where its capability to identify micro-defects or structural deviations directly determines product quality and production efficiency. The scarcity and unpredictability of anomalous samples pose significant challenges to supervised learning paradigms, rendering unsupervised frameworks trained on normal data the dominant solution.
blocks.zh: 工业异常检测已成为精密制造的关键技术[1],其识别微缺陷或结构偏差的能力直接决定了产品质量和生产效率. 异常样本的稀缺性和不可预测性对监督学习模式构成重大挑战,使在正常数据方面培训的无监督框架成为主导解决方案。

blocks.en: While RGB-based unsupervised methods like PatchCore [ 2 ] , SimpleNet [ 3 ] , and RD [ 4 , 5 ] have achieved remarkable progress in detecting color/texture anomalies, they inherently struggle with defects defined by physical depth. Flaws such as indentations or warpage are confounded by photometric inconsistencies like specular reflections and shadows. This fundamental limitation underscores the necessity of incorporating 3D geometry data to capture the true physical structure of defects. Consequently, modern industrial inspection is shifting towards a multimodal paradigm. RGB images excel at capturing rich, high-resolution texture and color information, but lack explicit depth cues. Conversely, 3D point clouds provide precise geometric measurements but are often sparse and lack fine-grained texture details. Fusing these complementary modalities is therefore essential for developing a comprehensive and reliable detection system, motivating our work to create an effective integration framework.
blocks.zh: 虽然基于RGB的无监督方法,如PatchCore [2],SimpleNet [3],和RD [4,5],在检测颜色/纹理异常方面取得了显著进展,但它们在本质上与由物理深度定义的缺陷相抗衡. 凹陷或页等花纹被光度不一致如光谱反射和阴影所混淆. 这一根本性的限制突出了纳入三维几何数据以捕捉缺陷的真正物理结构的必要性. 因此,现代工业检查正转向多式联运模式。 RGB图像在捕捉丰富,高分辨率的纹理和色彩信息方面表现优异,但缺乏明确的深度提示. 反之,三维点云提供精确的几何测量,但往往稀少并缺乏精细的纹理细节. 因此,消除这些互补模式对于发展全面和可靠的检测系统至关重要,这激励了我们创建有效一体化框架的工作。

blocks.en: Early multimodal approaches such as BTF [ 6 ] , Shape-Guided [ 7 ] , M3DM [ 8 ] and LSFA [ 9 ] , rely on memory banks to store normal features during training and compute anomaly scores via feature space discrepancy during testing. However, these memory-intensive methods suffer from prohibitive memory consumption and slow inference speeds, limiting their practicality in industrial settings.
blocks.zh: BTF [6],Shape-Guided [7],M3DM [8]和LSFA [9]等早期多模式方法,依靠记忆库在训练时存储正常特性,在测试时通过特征空间差异来计算异常分. 然而,这些内存密集型的方法却受到令人望而却步的内存消耗和推论速度缓慢的影响,限制了它们在工业环境下的实用性.

blocks.en: In contrast, emerging feature reconstruction paradigms employ a parametric reconstruction network (e.g., encoder-decoder or trainable MLP) to achieve multimodal anomaly detection without explicit memory construction. This effectively resolves memory and efficiency limitations while maintaining detection accuracy.
blocks.zh: 相形之下,新兴的地物重建范式采用了一个参数重建网络(例如编码器-解码器或可训练的MLP),在没有明确的内存构造的情况下实现多模式异常检测. 这有效解决了内存和效率限制,同时保持了检测的准确性.

blocks.en: Figure 1 : A comparison between existing feature reconstruction methods and FBR. (a) Intra-Modal Reconstruction. (b) Cross-Modal Reconstruction. (c) Our proposed Fusion-Before-Reconstruction.
blocks.zh: 图1:现有特征重建方法与FBR的比较. (a) 山区内部重建。 (b) 跨山地重建。 (c) 我们提议的融合-重建前。

blocks.en: As shown in Figure 1 , existing feature reconstruction methods can be categorized into intra-modal reconstruction and cross-modal reconstruction. Taking point cloud modality and image modality as an example, depicted in Figure 1 (a), intra-modal reconstruction operates as follows: Both modalities first pass through modality-specific feature extractors to obtain extracted features. These features are then processed by a reconstruction network to generate corresponding reconstructed features. The detection results are obtained by comparing modality-specific extracted features, which are subsequently fused to produce the final outcome. However, this approach only performs reconstruction within individual modalities, neglecting the complementary information between modalities. In contrast, the cross-modal paradigm shown in Figure 1 (b) fundamentally differs by establishing bidirectional reconstruction links between modalities. Instead of reconstructing features within the same modality, it trains two mutual translation networks: one converts the point cloud’s features into pseudo image features mimicking the visual modality, while another translates image features into pseudo point cloud representations. Anomalies are detected by measuring inconsistencies between each modality’s original features and their cross-modal reconstructed counterparts. Nevertheless, this method requires high semantic alignment between different modal features and suffers from one-to-many mismatches, particularly the inherent ambiguity when reconstructing high-dimensional 3D point clouds from low-dimensional 2D images, which may lead to false positives.
blocks.zh: 如图1所示,现有的特征重建方法可分为模式内重建和跨模式重建。 图1 (a) 以点云模式和图像模式为例,模式内重建的运作如下: 两种模式首先通过模式特定特征提取器,以获得被提取的特征. 这些特征再由重建网络处理,生成相应的重建特征. 检测结果是通过比较特定模式所提取的特性获得的,这些特性随后被熔接以产生最终结果. 然而,这种办法只按个别模式进行重建,忽略了模式之间的补充信息。 相比之下,图1(b)所示的跨模式模式在模式之间建立了双向重建联系,因而有着根本的不同。 它不是在同一个模式内重建特征,而是培训两个相互翻译网络:一个将点云的特征转换为模仿视觉模式的伪图像特征;另一个将图像特征转换为伪点云表示. 通过衡量每种模式的原始特征与其跨模式重建的对应特征之间的不一致,发现异常现象。 尽管如此,这种方法要求不同模式特征之间的高语义相接,并有一对多的不匹配现象,特别是在从低维二维图像重建高维三维点云时的内在模糊,这可能导致假阳性.

blocks.en: To address these issues, we propose a novel feature reconstruction paradigm called Fuse Before Reconstruct(FBR), depicted in Figure 1 (c). Unlike intra-modal methods operating in isolated feature spaces or cross-modal approaches relying on fragile feature translation, FBR establishes a shared semantic space through early-stage feature fusion. This architecture demonstrates two key advantages over traditional approaches.
blocks.zh: 为了解决这些问题,我们提议采用图1(c)所描述的Fuse Before reconstruct(FBR)这一新的特征重建模式。 与依赖脆弱地物翻译的孤立地物空间或跨地物方法运行的模式内方法不同,FBR通过早期地物聚变建立了共享语义空间. 这一结构显示出两个比传统方法重要的优势。

blocks.en: (1) Firstly, FBR combines features from both point cloud and image through a multi-modal fusion network, creating unified features. This process connects isolated single-modal information, allowing reconstructed features to contain complementary context. For example, point cloud geometry helps image features understand object occlusion, while image textures guide the semantic interpretation of sparse point clouds. (2) Besides, spatial and semantic alignment is dynamically achieved through cross-modal attention and gated fusion. Unlike traditional methods requiring explicit feature mapping, FBR automatically learns inter-modal relationships during fusion. For inherent ambiguities in cross-modal reconstruction, particularly the dimensional mismatch between 2D images and 3D point clouds, FBR implements dual constraint mechanisms. When reconstructing image features from point cloud data, explicit projection relationships between 3D coordinates and 2D pixels are encoded. Conversely, geometrical consistency constraints are enforced during the reconstruction of point cloud features from image data. This symmetrical constraint design maintains cross-modal mapping consistency while preserving modality-specific attributes, effectively mitigating reconstruction ambiguities.
blocks.zh: (1) 首先,FBR通过多式聚变网络,从点云和图像两个方面结合特征,形成统一的特征. 这一过程连接了孤立的单一模式信息,使重建的特征能够包含互补上下文. 例如:点云几何帮助图像特征理解物体被隐蔽,而图像纹理则指导了稀有点云的语义解释. (2) 此外,空间和语义对接是通过跨模式关注和入门聚变而动态地实现的. 与传统方法要求明确特征映射不同,FBR在聚变过程中自动学习模式间关系. 对于跨模式重建中固有的模糊性,尤其是2D图像和3D点云之间的维不匹配,FBR执行双重约束机制. 在从点云数据重建图像特征时,3D坐标和2D像素之间的明确投影关系被编码. 相反地,在从图像数据中重建点云特征的过程中,执行几何一致性限制. 这种对称的制约设计保持了跨模式绘图的一致性,同时保留了模式特有的属性,有效地减轻了重建的模糊性.

blocks.en: To implement these design principles, the FBR framework comprises three core components: Bidirectional Cross-Modal Attention (BiCMA), Spatial-Gated Adaptive Fusion (SGAF), and Multi-Modal Collaborative Reconstruction (MMCR). The BiCMA module facilitates preliminary feature integration through multi-progressive stages, effectively harmonizing point cloud and image modalities. Subsequently, SGAF performs spatially adaptive fusion to achieve refined feature synthesis through gated modulation. Finally, MMCR reconstructs the original features via collaborative decoding from both modalities. The effectiveness of the proposed FBR framework is extensively validated on established 3D anomaly detection benchmarks, including MVTec 3D-AD and Eyecandies. Our method achieves superior performance compared to existing feature reconstruction SOTA [ 10 ] , attaining 98.3% (+2.9%) I-AUROC on MVTec 3D-AD and 92.6% (+4.1%) I-AUROC on Eyecandies, marking the new state-of-the-art result.
blocks.zh: 为执行这些设计原则,联邦空间局框架由三个核心部分组成:双向跨周期关注(BICMA),空间组合适应(SGAF)和多周期协作重建(MMCR)。 BiCMA模块通过多相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相 随后,SGAF进行空间适应聚变,以通过入门调制实现精细地特征合成. 最后,MMCR通过两种方式的协作解码重建了原始特征. 拟议的FBR框架的有效性在既定的3D异常探测基准上得到广泛验证,包括MVTec 3D-AD和Eyecandies. 我们的方法与现有的特征重建SOTA[10]相比,取得了优异的性能,在MVTec 3D-AD上达到了98.3%(+2.9%)的I-AUROC,在眼科上达到了92.6%(+4.1%)的I-AUROC,标志着新的先进成果.

blocks.en: In summary, our contributions are as follows: ∙ \bullet We propose FBR, a novel feature reconstruction paradigm that implements fusion-before-reconstruction for multimodal anomaly detection, which addresses the inherent limitations of conventional feature reconstruction approaches through cross-modal interaction prior to reconstruction. ∙ \bullet We propose BiCMA that employs a bidirectional cross-modal attention mechanism to achieve bidirectional complementary fusion of 2D-3D features through multi-stage optimization and dynamic local spatial prior injection. ∙ \bullet We propose SGAF that enables pixel-wise context-aware fusion. By dynamically generating spatial-adaptive weights through learnable gating units, SGAF achieves localized complementary integration of cross-modal features while maintaining structural consistency. ∙ \bullet Extensive experiments on MVTec 3D-AD and Eyecandies demonstrate that FBR achieves state-of-the-art performance.
blocks.zh: 总之,我们的贡献如下: 我们提议采用FBR,这是一种新的特征重建范式,用于多模式异常探测的聚变后再重建,通过在重建前的跨模式互动,解决传统特征重建方法的固有局限性。 * 弹出 我们建议采用双向跨模式注意机制的双向双相系统,通过多相优化和动态本地空间先入后出,实现2D-3D特征的双相互补融合。 * 弹出 我们提议使用能够像素上下文感应到聚变的SGAF。 SGAF通过可学习的地标单位,动态地产生空间适应权重,实现跨模式特征的局部互补融合,同时保持结构上的一致性. * 有关MVTec 3D-AD和Eyecandies的广泛实验表明,FBR达到了最先进的性能。

blocks.en: We propose FBR, a novel feature reconstruction paradigm that implements fusion-before-reconstruction for multimodal anomaly detection, which addresses the inherent limitations of conventional feature reconstruction approaches through cross-modal interaction prior to reconstruction.
blocks.zh: 我们提议采用FBR,这是一种新的特征重建范式,用于多模式异常探测的聚变后再重建,通过在重建前的跨模式互动,解决传统特征重建方法的固有局限性。

blocks.en: We propose BiCMA that employs a bidirectional cross-modal attention mechanism to achieve bidirectional complementary fusion of 2D-3D features through multi-stage optimization and dynamic local spatial prior injection.
blocks.zh: 我们建议采用双向跨模式注意机制的双向双相系统,通过多相优化和动态本地空间先入后出,实现2D-3D特征的双相互补融合。

blocks.en: We propose SGAF that enables pixel-wise context-aware fusion. By dynamically generating spatial-adaptive weights through learnable gating units, SGAF achieves localized complementary integration of cross-modal features while maintaining structural consistency.
blocks.zh: 我们提议使用能够像素上下文感应到聚变的SGAF。 SGAF通过可学习的地标单位,动态地产生空间适应权重,实现跨模式特征的局部互补融合,同时保持结构上的一致性.

blocks.en: Extensive experiments on MVTec 3D-AD and Eyecandies demonstrate that FBR achieves state-of-the-art performance.
blocks.zh: 关于MVTec 3D-AD和Eyecandies的广泛实验表明,FBR实现了最先进的性能.

blocks.en: 2 RELATED WORK
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: 2.1 2D Industrial Anomaly Detection
blocks.zh: 2.1 2D 工业异常检测

blocks.en: The domain of 2D industrial anomaly detection, primarily focused on image-based analysis, has matured significantly since the introduction of benchmark datasets like MVTec AD [ 11 ] . Methodologies can be broadly classified into two dominant paradigms: feature embedding and reconstruction-based approaches.
blocks.zh: 2D产业异常检测领域主要以图像分析为主,自采用"MVTec AD"等基准数据集后已显著成熟. 方法可大致分为两个主导范式:特征嵌入法和以重建为基础的方法。

blocks.en: Feature Embedding Approaches. This paradigm operates by transforming images into a discriminative feature space where normal and anomalous samples can be distinguished. It is primarily realized through two strategies: (1) Teacher-Student Frameworks : Methods like Uninformed-Students [ 12 ] , MKD [ 13 ] , and RD++ [ 5 ] employ knowledge distillation. In this setup, a student network is trained to mimic the feature representations of a powerful, pre-trained teacher network on normal data. As anomalous regions are out-of-distribution, they cause a significant divergence between the student’s and teacher’s feature maps, which serves as the anomaly signal. (2) Memory Bank Methods : In contrast, non-parametric approaches such as PatchCore [ 2 ] , CFA [ 14 ] , and FOCT [ 15 ] construct an explicit memory bank—a comprehensive library of feature vectors extracted from normal training samples. During inference, a test sample’s features are compared against this bank. Anomaly scores are typically derived from the distance to the nearest neighbor(s) in the feature space, effectively identifying samples that deviate from the learned normality.
blocks.zh: 特色嵌入法. 这种范式的运作方式是将图像转化为一个区别特征空间,在那里可以区分出正常和异常的样本. 它主要通过两个战略来实现: (1) 师生框架: 诸如不知情学生[12]、MKD[13]和RD++[5]等方法采用知识蒸馏法。 在这个设置中,一个学生网络被训练来模仿一个在正常数据上被预先训练过的强大教师网络的特征表现. 由于异常区域是分布外的,它们造成学生和教师的地貌图相去甚远,成为异常信号. (2) 记忆库方法: 相形之下,PatchCore[2],CAF[14],FOCT[15]等非参数化方法构建了明确的内存库——一个从正常训练样本中提取的特征向量综合库. 在推论期间,一个测试样本的特征被比作这个库. 异常分数一般取自地物空间中距离最近的邻居,有效识别出偏离所学常态的样本.

blocks.en: Reconstruction-based Approaches. This paradigm is founded on the principle that a model trained exclusively on normal data will fail to accurately reproduce anomalous patterns. These methods leverage a variety of powerful generative architectures, including Autoencoders (AEs) [ 16 , 17 , 18 ] , Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) [ 19 , 20 ] , and more recently, Transformers [ 21 , 22 ] and Diffusion Models [ 23 , 24 ] . The model is optimized to minimize the reconstruction error (at either the pixel or feature level) for normal images. At inference, anomalous regions manifest as areas with high reconstruction error, which can be easily thresholded to create an anomaly map.
blocks.zh: 基于重建的办法。 这种范式的基础是,一个完全接受正常数据培训的模型将无法准确复制异常模式。 这些方法利用了各种强大的基因架构,包括Autoencoders(AEs)[16,17,18],General Aversarial Networks(GANs)[19,20],以及更近的变形器[21,22]和分化模型[23,24]. 该模型被优化,以最小化正常图像的重建出错(无论是像素还是特征级别). 推断出,异常区域表现为重建出高出错的区域,很容易被阈值来生成出异常地图.

blocks.en: Despite their remarkable success, all these 2D-centric methods are inherently confined to information captured within the RGB color space. They excel at identifying texture or color deviations but often struggle to reliably detect defects defined by physical geometry, such as subtle indentations, scratches, or structural warping, which may have minimal visual signatures. This fundamental limitation highlights the necessity of incorporating complementary data modalities, such as 3D geometry, which has catalyzed the development of the multimodal anomaly detection techniques discussed next.
blocks.zh: 尽管取得了显著的成功,但所有这些以2D为中心的方法本质上都局限于在RGB色彩空间内获取的信息. 它们擅长辨别纹理或颜色偏差,但往往难以可靠地检测出由物理几何学定义的缺陷,如细微的缩入,划痕,或结构扭曲等,它们可能具有最小的视觉特征. 这一基本限制突出了纳入补充数据模式的必要性,例如三维几何,它催化了下文所讨论多式联运异常探测技术的发展。

blocks.en: 2.2 Multimodal Industrial Anomaly Detection
blocks.zh: 2.2 多式联运工业异常检测

blocks.en: The release of challenging benchmarks like MVTec 3D-AD [ 25 ] and Eyecandies [ 26 ] has spurred significant research in multimodal industrial anomaly detection. Existing methods can be broadly categorized based on how they process and compare multimodal features: independent feature space methods, memory bank-based methods, and feature reconstruction-based methods.
blocks.zh: 发布MVTec 3D-AD[25]和Eyecandies[26]等具有挑战性的基准,推动了对多模式工业异常探测的重要研究。 现有方法可以根据其处理和比较多式联运特征的方式进行广泛的分类:独立的地物空间方法、基于存储库的方法和基于重建的地物方法。

blocks.en: Independent Feature Space Approaches. These methods process each modality in separate streams and combine their outputs at a later stage, often through simple concatenation or knowledge distillation. For instance, the teacher-student framework is a prominent example. 3D-ST [ 27 ] pioneered knowledge distillation for point cloud anomaly detection but was limited to a single modality. Its successor, AST [ 28 ] , extended this to a multimodal setting by combining RGB and point cloud features via simple feature concatenation, yet lacked deep interaction between modalities. Similarly, the extension of DFR [ 17 ] to multimodal detection [ 10 ] also reconstructed features for each modality independently before fusing the results. The core limitation of these approaches is their failure to leverage rich cross-modal complementary information during the critical feature encoding stage.
blocks.zh: 独立地物空间方法. 这些方法将每种方式分流处理,并在后期结合其输出,通常通过简单的接合或知识分馏. 例如,师生框架就是一个突出的例子。 3D-ST [27]为点云异常探测开创了知识分馏,但仅限于一种模式. 它的后继者AST [28],通过简单的地物结合将RGB和点云特征结合,将它扩展至多模式设置,但模式之间缺乏深度互动. 同样地,DFR[17]扩展至多式检测[10]也为每种模式独立地重建了特性,然后将结果相接。 这些方法的核心局限性是在关键特征编码阶段未能利用丰富的跨模式补充信息。

blocks.en: Memory Bank-based Approaches. Drawing inspiration from their success in 2D anomaly detection, memory bank methods store a comprehensive library of normal features during training. Anomalies are then detected by comparing test features against this stored bank. In the multimodal context, BTF [ 6 ] extracts and concatenates RGB and geometric features, but this simple fusion overlooks inter-modal dependencies. M3DM [ 8 ] improves upon this by using three separate memory banks for image, point cloud, and contrastively learned fused features, but its complexity increases. Shape-Guided [ 7 ] also employs dual memory banks to enforce cross-modal consistency. While effective, these methods are fundamentally plagued by prohibitive memory consumption and slow inference speeds, making them impractical for deployment in resource-constrained industrial environments.
blocks.zh: 基于记忆银行的方法。 从他们在2D异常检测中的成功中获得灵感,内存库方法在训练期间存储了一个包含正常特性的综合库. 然后通过将测试特征与这个存储库进行比较来检测异常。 在多模式上下文中,BTF [6]取出并缩合了RGB和几何特征,但这种简单的聚变忽略了模式间依赖关系. M3DM [8]通过使用三个独立的内存库进行图像,点云,以及对比性地学习到的被熔化的特性来改进这一点,但其复杂性会增加. 成形-Guided [7] 也使用双重记忆库执行跨模式一致性. 这些方法虽然有效,但从根本上说却受到令人望而却步的内存消耗和缓慢的推论速度的困扰,使它们无法在资源受限的工业环境中部署。

blocks.en: Feature Reconstruction-based Approaches. To overcome the limitations of memory banks, reconstruction-based methods have emerged as a more efficient alternative. These methods train a parametric network to reconstruct normal data features, with high reconstruction error indicating an anomaly. EasyNet [ 29 ] offers a real-time image-level reconstruction solution but falters on small or low-contrast defects. Within the multimodal domain, these methods follow two main paradigms: (1) Intra-modal Reconstruction: This approach, exemplified by the multimodal extension of DFR [ 17 , 10 ] , reconstructs features within each modality’s own space before fusing the anomaly scores. As mentioned, this design inherently misses the opportunity for cross-modal feature enhancement. (2) Cross-modal Reconstruction: Pioneered by CFM [ 10 ] , this paradigm attempts to translate features from one modality to another (e.g., from image to point cloud). Anomalies are detected via inconsistencies in this cross-modal mapping. However, this approach is highly susceptible to projection errors and ambiguous one-to-many mappings (e.g., a single texture corresponding to multiple possible geometries), leading to unreliable detection.
blocks.zh: 以重建为主的方法。 为了克服记忆库的局限性,基于重建的方法已经成为一种更有效的替代办法。 这些方法训练出一个参数网络来重建正常的数据特性,高重重建出错误表明异常. EasyNet [29] 提供了实时图像级重建解决方案,但因小或低相接缺陷而动摇. 在多式联运领域,这些方法遵循两个主要模式: (1) 模式内重建: 这种方法以DFR[17,10]的多式扩展为例,在消除异常分数之前,在每种模式自己的空间内重建特征。 如前所述,这种设计本身就错过了加强跨模式特征的机会。 (2) 跨模式重建: 由CFM [10]作先锋,这个范式试图将特征从一种模式翻译到另一种模式(例如从图像转换到点云). 通过这种跨模式绘图中的不一致之处,发现了异常现象。 然而,这种方法极易被投影出错和模棱两可的一对多相映射(例如,一个单一的纹理对应多个可能的几何)所影响,导致检测不可靠.

blocks.en: In summary, existing multimodal methods face a critical dilemma. Independent feature space and intra-modal reconstruction methods are efficient but fail to exploit deep cross-modal synergies. Memory bank methods achieve better fusion but are too resource-intensive. Cross-modal reconstruction attempts to bridge this gap but introduces significant mapping ambiguity and alignment challenges. This reveals a fundamental gap in the literature: the lack of a paradigm that can achieve deep, synergistic fusion while remaining efficient and avoiding ambiguous mappings.
blocks.zh: 简而言之,现有的多式联运方法面临一个关键的两难境地。 独立的地物空间和模式内重建方法是有效的,但未能利用深刻的跨模式协同作用。 记忆库方法可以实现更好的聚变,但资源过于密集。 跨模式重建试图弥合这一差距,但带来了重大的绘图模糊和调整挑战。 这揭示出文献中的一个基本差距:缺乏一个既能实现深度协同核聚变又能保持高效并能避免模棱两可的绘图的范式.

blocks.en: To address these limitations, we propose FBR, a novel feature reconstruction-based paradigm. By first fusing multimodal features into a shared, robust representation and then performing reconstruction, FBR establishes strong inter-modal consistency early on. This fundamentally resolves the issues of insufficient interaction and mapping ambiguity that plague previous methods, leading to a more accurate and reliable detection framework.
blocks.zh: 为了克服这些局限性,我们提出了FBR, 一个基于重建的新特色范式. 通过首先将多式特征融合成一个共同的、有力的代表性,然后进行重建,《联邦示范法》在早期就建立了强有力的模式间一致性。 这从根本上解决了困扰以往方法的互动和摸底模糊性不足的问题,从而形成了一个更加准确可靠的检测框架。

3.4 Multi-Modal Collaborative Reconstruction
blocks.zh: 3.4 多阶段合作重建

blocks.en: The final fused feature F f ​ i ​ n ​ a ​ l {F}_{{final}} fully captures the information from both modalities. We develop two modality-specific reconstruction decoders, ϕ 2 ​ D \phi_{2D} and ϕ 3 ​ D \phi_{3D} , to project F f ​ i ​ n ​ a ​ l F_{{final}} back to their original representation spaces. These decoders generate reconstructed image features F ^ 2 ​ D ∈ ℝ H × W × C 2 ​ D \hat{{F}}_{2D}\in\mathbb{R}^{H\times W\times C_{2D}} and point cloud features F ^ 3 ​ D ∈ ℝ H × W × C 3 ​ D \hat{{F}}_{3D}\in\mathbb{R}^{H\times W\times C_{3D}} through: F ^ 2 ​ D = ϕ 2 ​ D ​ ( F f ​ i ​ n ​ a ​ l ) F ^ 3 ​ D = ϕ 3 ​ D ​ ( F f ​ i ​ n ​ a ​ l ) \hat{{F}}_{2D}=\phi_{2D}({F}_{final})\quad\hat{{F}}_{3D}=\phi_{3D}({F}_{final}) (11) where both ϕ 2 ​ D \phi_{2D} and ϕ 3 ​ D \phi_{3D} are implemented as lightweight MLPs. Notably, to handle spatial misalignment between modalities, we implement an adaptive zero-padding strategy: pixel positions without corresponding point cloud observations are masked and filled with zero vectors in the feature maps.

blocks.en: During the testing phase, we compute modality-specific anomaly score maps by evaluating the Euclidean Distance between original and reconstructed features across both modalities. Formally, for a given test sample, we derive two distinct anomaly score maps M 2 ​ D ∈ ℝ H × W {M}_{2D}\in\mathbb{R}^{H\times W} and M 3 ​ D ∈ ℝ H × W {M}_{3D}\in\mathbb{R}^{H\times W} : M 2 ​ D = ‖ F 2 ​ D − F ^ 2 ​ D ‖ M 3 ​ D = ‖ F 3 ​ D − F ^ 3 ​ D ‖ {M}_{2D}=\|{F}_{2D}-\hat{{F}}_{2D}\|\quad{M}_{3D}=\|{F}_{3D}-\hat{{F}}_{3D}\| (15)
blocks.zh: 在测试阶段,我们通过评价欧几利得在两种模式中原有特征与重建特征之间的距离,计算出特定模式的异常分数图. 在形式上,对于给定的测试样本,我们得出了两个明显的异常分数地图 M 2 D → R H × W {M}_{2D}\in\ mathbb{R}^{H\times W}和 M 3 D R H× W {M}_{3D}\in\ mathbb{R}^{H\times W}:M 2 D = ‖ F 2 D → F → 二 D → M 3 D = ‖ F → F 3 D → F → { D → {-- hat- hat- hat- hat- hat- {{- {{- {{- {{- {{- (15).

blocks.en: Finally, consistent with [ 8 ] and [ 10 ] , we apply a Gaussian kernel of size 4 to smooth the final anomaly map, and then use the maximum value of the anomaly score map s = max ⁡ ( M ) s=\max({M}) as the image-level anomaly score.

blocks.en: 4.1 Experiments Settings
blocks.zh: 4.1 实验设置

blocks.en: Dataset. MVTec 3D-AD [ 25 ] is an industrial multi-modal anomaly detection dataset containing 10 industrial object categories. It comprises 2,656 training samples, 294 validation samples, and 1,197 test samples. The test dataset includes various types of anomalies such as scratches, dents, and contamination, each with precise ground truth annotations. Eyecandies [ 26 ] is a synthetic dataset specifically designed for multi-modal anomaly detection and localization. It contains approximately 90,000 high-quality, realistic samples from 10 categories of candies, cookies and desserts. Each category exhibits considerable variations in shape, texture, and material, with randomization applied to enhance diversity across the dataset.
blocks.zh: 数据集. MVTec 3D-AD [25]是一个工业多模式异常探测数据集,包含10个工业对象类别. 其中包括2 656个培训样本、294个鉴定样本和1 197个测试样本。 测试数据集包括各种异常类型,如抓痕,凹陷和被污染,每组都有准确的地面真实说明. Eyecandies [26]是一个专门为多式异常探测和本地化而设计的合成数据集. 它包含约9万个高质量,现实的样本,取自10类糖果,饼干和甜点. 每个类别在形状、纹理和材料方面都表现出相当大的差异,并采用随机化方法来增加整个数据集的多样性。

blocks.en: Evaluation Metrics. Similar to the metrics used in MVtec 3D-AD and EyeCandies, we evaluate image anomaly detection performance by the Area Under the Receiver Operating Characteristic Curve (I-AUROC). Following standard evaluation protocols, we report the pixel-level Area Under the Receiver Operating Characteristic Curve (P-AUROC) and the Area Under the Per-Region Overlap (AUPRO). To assess performance in practical scenarios where low false positives are critical, we compute AUPRO over a False Positive Rate (FPR) range up to 30% (AUPRO@30%) and a more stringent range up to 1% (AUPRO@1%).
blocks.zh: 评价计量。 与MVtec 3D-AD和EyeCandies中使用的度量衡类似,我们对接收器操作特征曲线下区域(I-AUROC)的图像异常检测性能进行评估. 遵循标准评价协议,我们报告接收器操作特征曲线下像素级区域(P-AUROC)和每个区域重叠下的区域(AUPRO)。 为了评估低假阳性临界的实际情况中的表现,我们计算AUPRO的假阳性率(FPR)在30%(AUPRO@30%)和更严格的范围在1%(AUPRO@1%)。

blocks.en: Data Preprocessing. We apply the background removal strategy outlined in BTF [ 6 ] for preprocessing the point cloud modality. The RANSAC algorithm is employed to estimate the background plane, and points within a distance of 0.005 are classified as background. This step ensures that the subsequent feature extraction focuses on the target object, effectively minimizing interference from irrelevant background information.
blocks.zh: 数据预处理. 我们采用BTF [6]中概述的背景去除策略来预处理点云模式. RANSAC算法用于估计背景平面,距离0.005的点被归类为背景. 这一步骤确保了后续的特征提取侧重于目标对象,有效地将无关背景资料的干扰降到最低.

blocks.en: Implementation Details. During training and inference, all images are resized to a resolution of 224 × 224 224\times 224 . We utilize the DINO ViT-B/8 [ 33 , 34 ] pre-trained on ImageNet [ 35 ] as the 2D feature extractor 𝒯 2 ​ D \mathcal{T}_{2D} . After passing the image through 𝒯 2 ​ D \mathcal{T}_{2D} , a feature map of size 28 × 28 × 768 28\times 28\times 768 is generated, which is then bilinearly upsampled to F 2 ​ D ∈ ℝ 224 × 224 × 768 {F}_{2D}\in\mathbb{R}^{224\times 224\times 768} .
blocks.zh: 执行细节。 在培训和推论期间,所有图像都被调整为分辨率为224×224\times 224。 我们利用在ImageNet上预先训练的DINO VIT-B/8 [33,34] 作为2D特性提取器 T 2 D\Mathcal{T}_{2D}。 在将图像通过 T 2 D \ mathcal{T}_{2D} 之后, 生成了 28 × 28 × 768 28\times 28\times 768 的地物映射图, 然后双线上复制到 F 2 D → R 224 × 224 × 768 {F}_{2 D}\in\timthb{R}^{224\times 224\times 768} 。

blocks.en: We employ the Point-MAE [ 36 ] pre-trained on ShapeNet [ 37 ] as the 3D feature extractor 𝒯 3 ​ D \mathcal{T}_{3D} . Similar to previous work [ 8 , 10 ] , we first downsample the point cloud using the farthest point sampling (FPS) [ 38 ] to obtain 1,024 groups, each containing 32 points. These groups are then fed into the 𝒯 3 ​ D \mathcal{T}_{3D} to produce 1024 feature vectors, which serve as the feature vectors f c {f}_{c} for the center points of each group. To obtain the feature vector for each individual point in the point cloud, we identify the three nearest already extracted feature vectors, and perform distance-weighted interpolation to compute the feature vector f q {f}_{q} for each point. This process yields the original 3D feature set F o ​ r ​ i ∈ ℝ N × C 3 ​ D {F}_{ori}\in\mathbb{R}^{N\times C_{3D}} for the complete point cloud, where N N represents the total number of points and C 3 ​ D C_{3D} denotes the 3D feature channels. In accordance with the standard dataset configuration [ 25 , 26 ] that assumes a one-to-one correspondence between pixels and points, we subsequently project these 3D features onto a 2D plane through perspective transformation. This spatial mapping produces the 3D feature map F 3 ​ D ∈ {F}_{3D}\in with dimensions 224 × 224 × 1152 224\times 224\times 1152 .
blocks.zh: 我们使用 ShapeNet 上的 Point-MAE [36] 预训 [37] 作为 三维特性提取器 T 3 D\ mathcal{T}_{3D} 。 与前作相类似 [8, 10],我们首先用最远的点采样(FPS) [38] 来取出1,024个组,每个组包含32个点. 这些组再被输入到T 3 D\ mathcal{T}_{3D},以产生出1024个特性向量,作为每个组的中点的特性向量fc{f}_{c}. 为了获得点云中每个点的特性向量,我们确定三个已经提取的特性向量,并进行相距加权内插来计算每个点的特性向量 f {f}_{q}. 这个过程为完整点云产生原始的3D特性设置F o r i ∈ R × C → C {F}_{ori}\in\ mathbb{R}^{N\times C_{3D}},其中N代表点数总数而C 3 D C_{3D}表示3D特性通道. 根据假设像素和点之间的一对一对应的标准数据集配置[25,26],我们随后通过视角转换将这些3D特性投射到2D平面上. 这种空间映射产生了3D特征图F 3 D {F}_{3D}\in 有尺寸 224×224×1152 2.24\times 224\times 1152.

blocks.en: Qualitative comparison. To facilitate qualitative comparison, Figure 3 and Figure 4 visualize the anomaly segmentation results of our FBR against M3DM [ 8 ] and CFM [ 10 ] on MVTec 3D-AD and Eyecandies datasets, respectively. As evidenced by the qualitative results, both M3DM and CFM exhibit pronounced false-positive artifacts that significantly degrade their anomaly detection and localization performance. In contrast, our method demonstrates superior performance in suppressing false alarms while achieving more precise anomaly localization, particularly evident in complex texture regions and subtle geometric anomalies across both datasets. blocks.en: 4.3 Few Shot Anomaly Detection and Segmentation
blocks.zh: 4.3 极少发生异常探测和分解

blocks.en: Due to production environment variability and annotation costs, obtaining high-quality training data under normal operating conditions remains challenging. To evaluate the generalization capability of our method under scarce normal samples, we conduct few-shot anomaly detection experiments on MVTec 3D-AD by reducing the available normal training samples per category to 5-shot/10-shot/50-shot configurations. Under this setting, we compare our proposed method with previous state-of-the-art approaches including BTF [ 6 ] , AST [ 28 ] , M3DM [ 8 ] , and CFM [ 10 ] . As shown in Table 7 , our method achieves superior performance in image-level anomaly detection (I-AUROC) across different few-shot settings, demonstrating improvements of 5.8%, 6.5%, and 5.3% over the second-best results under 5-shot, 10-shot, and 50-shot configurations, respectively. Notably, with 50-shot training samples, our method attains 96.0% I-AUROC, already surpassing the 95.4% achieved by the second-best method (CFM) using full training data. For pixel-level anomaly segmentation metrics (P-AUROC, AUPRO@30%, AUPRO@1%), our approach achieves the best results in almost all experimental configurations, except for marginally inferior P-AUROC and AUPRO scores under the 5-shot setting compared to CFM. Particularly in the highly challenging AUPRO@1% metric, our method shows significant improvements of 5.2%, 1.5%, and 1.7% under 5-shot, 10-shot, and 50-shot configurations, respectively. These results demonstrate our method’s strong generalization capability under data scarcity conditions, which benefits from effective multi-modal information fusion that enables complementary modality interactions for enhanced anomaly detection and localization. We also compared the computational efficiency of our method against CFM and M3DM, with the detailed results presented in the supplementary material.

blocks.en: 5 CONCLUSION
blocks.zh: 5. 结 论

blocks.en: In this paper, we address the limitations of existing intra-modal and cross-modal feature reconstruction paradigms for industrial anomaly detection, in which conventional methods either neglect cross-modal complementary information or suffer from projection errors and ambiguous mappings. To overcome these challenges, we propose Fuse Before Reconstruct (FBR), a novel reconstruction framework that enables deep bidirectional interaction between multimodal features before reconstruction. Through bidirectional feature alignment via channel harmonization combined with dynamic spatial prior integration, our method mitigates projection bias while resolving mapping ambiguities through consistency-constrained dual decoding. Comprehensive experiments demonstrate that FBR achieves significantly better performance than previous methods while substantially improving existing feature reconstruction baselines. Our Fuse Before Reconstruct paradigm offers a new direction for multimodal anomaly detection, suggesting that deep, early-stage fusion is a more effective strategy than late-stage score merging or ambiguous cross-modal translation.
blocks.zh: 在本文件中,我们讨论了现有模式内和跨模式的局限性,即工业异常发现的重建模式,在这种模式中,传统方法要么忽略了跨模式互补信息,要么出现投影错误和模糊不清的绘图。 为了克服这些挑战,我们建议重建前的Fuse(重建前的FBR),这是一个新的重建框架,能够在重建前使多模式特征之间进行深入的双向互动。 通过通过信道协调与动态空间前集成相结合的双向特征对接,我们的方法减轻了投影偏差,同时通过受一致性限制的双重解码解决了绘图模糊问题. 全面的实验表明,FBR的性能大大好于以前的方法,同时大幅度地改进了现有的特征重建基线. 我们的Fuse Before reconstructive范式为多式联运异常探测提供了新的方向,表明深度,早期聚变比后期分数合并或模棱两可的跨模式翻译更有效.

blocks.en: A.1 The Effect of Different Transformer Pruning Layers
blocks.zh: A.1 不同变形器延伸层的影响

blocks.en: Both our 2D and 3D feature extractors employ 12-layer Transformer encoders. To evaluate the impact of different network depths on model performance, we conducted experiments on MVTec 3D-AD by progressively pruning both encoders to 8, 4, and 1 layers. As shown in Table 11 , increasing network depth consistently improves nearly all metrics (I-AUROC, P-AUROC, AUPRO) for both anomaly detection and localization, with optimal performance achieved at Layer 12. We attribute this phenomenon to the distinct characteristics of feature representations across layers: shallower layers preserve more localized patterns with limited inter-element interactions, whereas deeper layers progressively integrate broader contextual correlations through iterative processing of multi-layer self-attention mechanisms, ultimately yielding more representative and unified feature representations. This performance gain, however, comes at the cost of higher memory consumption and slower inference speeds.
blocks.zh: 我们的2D和3D特性提取器都采用了12层变形器编码器. 为了评价不同网络深度对模型性能的影响,我们通过将两个编码器逐步推向8,4和1层,对MVTec 3D-AD进行了实验. 如表11所示,网络深度不断提高,几乎所有的度量标准(I-AUROC、P-AUROC、AUPRO)都用于异常探测和本地化,并在第12层实现了最佳性能。 我们将此现象归因于地物表现层的不同特征:较浅地层保留了更局部的形态,具有有限的元素间相互作用;而更深地层则通过多层自觉机制的迭接处理,逐渐地整合了更广泛的上下文关联,最终产生更具代表性和统一的地物表现. 然而,这种性能增益是以更高的内存消耗和较慢的推断速度为代价的.

blocks.en: We quantitatively evaluated the computational efficiency by measuring average inference time and FPS across all test samples in MVTec 3D-AD. Our deepest configuration (Layer 12) achieves 19 FPS with an average inference time of 52.5 ms per sample, while the shallowest configuration (Layer 1) attains optimal efficiency at 23 FPS and 43.4 ms per sample. Notably, the performance degradation in inference speed from Layer 1 to Layer 12 (-4 FPS) is significantly outweighed by the substantial improvements in detection and localization accuracy (+5.8% in I-AUROC and +2.8% in AUPRO@1%). This favorable accuracy-efficiency trade-off justifies our selection of Layer 12 as the default configuration.
blocks.zh: 我们通过测量MVTec 3D-AD中所有测试样本的平均推断时间和FPS,对计算效率进行了定量评估。 我们最深的配置(Layer 12)达到19个FPS,每个样本的平均推断时间为52.5 ms;而最浅的配置(Layer 1)达到23个FPS和每个样本43.4 ms的最高效率. 值得注意的是,从第1层到第12层(-4 FPS)的性能降解率被探测和定位精度的大幅提高所大大超过(I-AUROC为+5.8%,AUPRO为+2.8%@1%)。 这种有利的精度效率取舍使我们有理由选择第12层作为默认配置.

The detailed configurations of each reconstruction network are as follows.

blocks.en: The convolutional encoder-decoder adopts a UNet-like architecture without skip connections. The encoder stage compresses spatial dimensions through two 3 × 3 3\times 3 convolutions (with ReLU activation) followed by 2 × 2 2\times 2 max pooling, while maintaining constant channel numbers. The decoder stage restores spatial dimensions via one 3 × 3 3\times 3 convolution (ReLU activation) and 2 × 2 2\times 2 transposed convolution, with the final layer adjusting channels to match target dimensions (768 for image feature channel or 1152 for point cloud channel). ReLU activation is applied to all layers except the output layer, enabling joint transformations for feature reconstruction.

blocks.en: The MLP encoder-decoder comprises an encoding stage, a bottleneck layer, and a decoding stage. For the 2D collaborative reconstruction network, the encoding stage contains two layers with neuron counts progressively halved (768 → 384 → 192), followed by a fixed-dimension bottleneck layer (192 neurons). The decoding stage then expands the neuron counts through two layers (192 → 384 → 1152). The 3D collaborative reconstruction network adopts a symmetric architecture (1152 → 288 → 288 → 576 → 768). All intermediate layers employ GeLU activation, except the final layer which uses no activation function. The MLP projectors are single-hidden-layer networks with layer dimensions 960 → 864 → 768 and 960 → 1042 → 1124, respectively.
blocks.zh: MLP编码器-解码器由一个编码阶段,一个瓶颈层,以及一个解码阶段组成. 对于2D合作重建网络来说,编码阶段包含两层,神经元计数逐渐减半(768 ~ 384 ~ 192),再接二连三地为固定分化瓶颈层(192个神经元). 解码阶段再通过两层来扩展神经元计数(192~384~1152). 三维协作重建网络采用对称结构(1152~288~288~576~768). 所有中间层都采用GELU活化,但最后层则不使用活化功能. MLP投影仪为单层隐藏式网络,分层尺寸分别为960~864~768和960~1042~1124.

blocks.en: As shown in Table 12 , the convolutional encoder-decoder achieved the poorest anomaly detection and localization performance, with an inference speed of only 9.1 FPS (110.1 ms per sample). This performance degradation may stem from computational redundancy caused by the local receptive fields in complex scenes. Notably, while the MLP encoder-decoder showed a 0.6% improvement in I-AUROC compared to the MLP projection, this advantage came at the cost of marginally lower P-AUROC (-0.1%) and significantly reduced inference efficiency (-1.9 FPS, +5.9 ms per sample). Through comprehensive evaluation of this performance-efficiency trade-off, we ultimately selected the MLP projection as our default configuration, as it maintains competitive detection accuracy while delivering superior computational efficiency for real-world deployment.
blocks.zh: 如表12所示,分解编码器实现了最差的异常检测和本地化性能,推论速度仅为9.1 FPS(每样110.1 ms). 这种性能退化可能源于复杂场景中局部可接受字段造成的计算冗余. 值得注意的是,虽然MLP编码器-解码器与MLP预测相比显示I-AUROC有0.6%的改进,但这种优势的代价是P-AUROC略低(-0.1%)并大大地降低了推论效率(1.9 FPS,每个样本+5.9 ms)。 通过对这种性能效率权衡的全面评估,我们最终选择了MLP投影作为我们的默认配置,因为它保持了竞争性检测精度,同时为现实世界的部署提供了更高的计算效率.

blocks.en: A.3 Comparasion of Different Feature Fusion Methods
blocks.zh: A.3 不同特征融合方法的比较

blocks.en: We compared our proposed fusion module (BiCMA + SGAF) with several general-purpose multimodal fusion methods from other domains. As shown in Table 13 , all fusion approaches achieved promising performance. This is because our core contribution lies in proposing a novel feature reconstruction paradigm that implements fusion-before-reconstruction for multimodal anomaly detection. As long as this framework effectively addresses multimodal fusion challenges, outstanding results can be attained.
blocks.zh: 我们把我们提议的聚变模块(BBCMA + SGAF)与其他领域的几种通用多式聚变方法进行了比较。 如表13所示,所有聚变办法都取得了令人乐观的业绩。 这是因为我们的核心贡献在于提出一个新的特征重建范式,在重建前实施聚变,以发现多模式异常。 只要这一框架能有效应对多模式融合的挑战,就能取得突出成果。

In contrast, while CFM [ 10 ] achieves accurate foreground localization in samples, it still exhibits certain over-detection phenomena. Notably, our proposed FBR method demonstrates superior precision in defect localization, effectively addressing these limitations.

blocks.en: A.5 Computational Efficiency Comparison
blocks.zh: A.5 计算效率比较

blocks.en: We conducted rigorous benchmarking of inference efficiency for M3DM [ 8 ] , CFM [ 10 ] , and our proposed FBR method on an identical NVIDIA RTX 4090 GPU, with comprehensive results summarized in Table 14 .
blocks.zh: 我们对M3DM[8]、CFM[10]的推论效率进行了严格的衡量基准,我们提议的FBR方法采用了相同的NVIDIA RTX 4090 GPU,综合结果见表14。

blocks.en: Compared to M3DM, FBR achieves exceptional efficiency with 40 × \times faster inference (49.8 ms vs 2001.2 ms), 92% lower memory (493.9 MB vs 6645.8 MB) and only 5.8% FLOPs(1249.2 G vs 21324.5 G), while outperforming it across all accuracy metrics (I-AUROC, P-AUROC, AUPRO@30%, AUPRO@1%).
blocks.zh: 与M3DM相比,FBR实现了特快的效率,以40×分(49.8 ms vs 2001.2 ms),92%的内存更低(493.9 MB vs 6645.8 MB)和5.8%的FLOPs(1249.2 G vs 21324.5 G),同时在所有精度度度度度度测量上都比它高(I-AUROC,P-AUROC,AUPRO@30%,AUPRO@1%).

blocks.en: Compared to the lightweight CFM, FBR incurs a moderate computational overhead: 1.7 × \times inference latency (49.8 ms vs 29.7 ms), 14% higher VRAM (493.9 MB vs 431.7 MB), and 2.9 × \times FLOPs (1249.2 G vs 431.1 G). This cost is justified by significant accuracy improvements across all metrics, effectively balancing space-time efficiency with performance.
blocks.zh: 与重量较轻的CFM相比,FBR产生中等的计算间接费用: 1.7 × 时间推论延迟(49.8 ms vs 29.7 ms),高14% VRAM (493.9 MB vs 431.7 MB), 2.9 × times FLOP (1249.2 G vs 431.1 G). 这一成本的理由是,所有指标的准确性都有了显著提高,有效地平衡了时空效率和性能。

blocks.en: A.6 Limitations and Future Work
blocks.zh: A.6 限制和未来的工作

blocks.en: We have demonstrated the superiority of the proposed FBR in multimodal anomaly detection task. In this subsection, we will discuss the two main limitations of our method and our future work.
blocks.zh: 我们已在多式联运异常探测任务中表现出拟议的FBR的优越性。 在本分节中,我们将讨论我们的方法和今后工作的两个主要局限。

blocks.en: First, while our method demonstrates effective defect localization for majority anomaly types, it struggles with identifying structural absences in object geometry. As empirically demonstrated in the bottom panel of Figure 6 (Cookie category), the detection framework exhibits edge-focused artifact detection along the perimeter regions of missing components rather than precise localization of actual missing geometries. This phenomenon reveals a fundamental technical bottleneck shared by M3DM [ 8 ] , Shape-Guided [ 29 ] , and CFM [ 10 ] architectures.
blocks.zh: 第一,虽然我们的方法表明多数异常类型存在有效的缺陷,但它难以识别物体几何结构上的缺失。 如图6(Cookie类)底板的经验所示,探测框架显示沿周边区域对缺失部件进行以边缘为重点的文物探测,而不是将实际缺失的几何元件精确地本地化。 这种现象揭示出M3DM[8],"形状-引导"[29],"CFM[10]架构"共同存在的一个基本技术瓶颈.

blocks.en: Second, while our method demonstrates superior performance on the Eyecandies dataset compared to existing approaches, substantial room for improvement remains in detecting objects with complex surface characteristics. This limitation is evident in the suboptimal localization results for CandyCane(Can. C.), ChocolateCookie(Cho. C.), and HazelnutTruffle(Haz. T.) categories, as illustrated in Figure 7 .
blocks.zh: 第二,虽然我们的方法表明,与现有方法相比,Eyecandies数据集的性能更好,但在探测具有复杂地表特征的物体方面仍有很大的改进余地。 如图7所示,CandyCane(Can.C.)、Coxycookie(Cho.C.)和Hazellnut Truffle(Haz.T.)类别的本地化结果不理想,就表明了这种局限性。

blocks.en: The aforementioned issues can be addressed by establishing a more unified joint representation space. Our approach essentially involves first constructing a joint feature space, which is then projected into separate feature spaces for individual modalities. The quality of the joint feature space construction directly impacts model9 performance, making the exploration of more efficient methods for building joint feature spaces a key focus of our future research.
blocks.zh: 上述问题可通过建立更加统一的联合代表空间加以解决。 我们的方法主要是首先建造一个共同的地物空间,然后将它投射成单独的地物空间,供个别方式使用。 联合特色空间建设的质量直接冲击模型9性能,使探索建设联合特色空间的更有效方法成为我们未来研究的重点.
